# User live mic test 2026-10-06: neutralization reaction, ionic equation.
Let us learn neutralization reaction.
Neutralization is when an acid reacts with base, they produce salt plus water.
The general reaction is acid plus base gives salt plus water. Example HCl plus NaOH gives NaCl plus H2O.
where HCl is hydrochloric acid NaOH is the sodium hydroxide base NaCl is the sodium chloride salt H2O is water
So what's happening? The acid provide H plus ions while the base provides OH negative ions. They combine H plus plus O minus gives H2O. So the acid and base neutralizes each other.
In one line, acid plus base gives salt plus water equals neutralization reaction.
